prospects.title: Prospecting
prospects.desc: Don't wait for inquiries: AI drafts your ideal customer profile, then finds buyers — searching Google for buyer websites and reading their public emails and phones (no account needed), or finding people by job title on Apollo. AI scores each and writes an opener; convert the good ones into inquiries to research, reply and follow up.
prospects.empty: Click "AI customer profile" at the top right: the assistant reads your company profile, products and documents, describes who to look for and turns it into search queries for buyer websites. Confirm, then click "Start prospecting": it searches Google in your Chrome (needs the Annulo extension), no account required.
prospects.icp_empty: No profile yet; click "AI customer profile".
prospects.src_web_desc: Searches Google in your Chrome, picks out buyer company websites and reads the public emails and phones on their home and contact pages. Free, no account; finds companies, not specific people.
prospects.src_apollo_desc: Finds specific people on Apollo by job title, location and industry. Needs an API key on a paid Apollo plan; revealing an email costs 1 credit per person.
prospects.no_browser: Website search uses your Chrome: install the Annulo extension in Chrome and keep Chrome open.
prospects.f_queries_hint: In English, one per line: product + buyer type + country, e.g. LED panel light distributor Germany. Avoid manufacturer / factory (those find competitors).
prospects.f_limit_web: Max companies to check in this batch
prospects.f_titles_hint: Comma separated: procurement manager, purchasing manager…
prospects.run_hint_web: Pauses a few seconds between queries; a few dozen companies take a few minutes. If Google asks for verification, complete it in Chrome, then click "Find more".
prospects.run_hint_apollo: Searching is free; revealing an email costs 1 Apollo credit per person.
prospects.pick: Tick to reveal emails in bulk
